visual_story.title: The file enters as raw pixels
visual_story.body: sample_specimen.jpg is 256×256. The specimen is staged in the secure sandbox. Nothing has been scored yet.
visual_story.footnote: Raw byte ingest verified • Zero server-side persistence

visual_story.title: Cryptographic file fingerprint
visual_story.body: SHA-256: e35751b8278bafe37e4e0ee8315b7cc0… Any single pixel modification alters this fingerprint completely. It confirms tamper-proof evidence provenance.

visual_story.title: MTCNN neural boundary lock
visual_story.body: MTCNN detected the facial boundary with 99.5% confidence. Bounding box coordinates isolate the subject from complex background.

visual_story.title: 5 Biometric facial anchor points
visual_story.body: Sub-pixel regression identified 5 keypoints (ocular pupils, nasal bridge, mouth corners). The inter-pupillary vector measures head roll tilt prior to alignment.

visual_story.title: Extracted subject window
visual_story.body: Crop strategy: mtcnn_margin. Irrelevant scene context outside the facial boundary is discarded to concentrate neural focus.

visual_story.title: Eyes leveled to canonical horizontal horizon
visual_story.body: The measured inter-ocular tilt angle was -10.044°. Affine rotation levels the eye axis to exactly 0.0° horizontal. Both EfficientNet and ViT require this standardized canonical alignment to avoid mistaking head tilt for synthesis anomalies.
visual_story.footnote: Bicubic Affine Rotation • Inter-Pupillary Axis Leveling

meta.reason: Rotated so the detected eye line is horizontal.

visual_story.title: Standardized 224×224 Normalization & RGB Split
visual_story.body: The leveled face crop is scaled to canonical neural dimensions (224×224×3) and normalized via ImageNet channel statistics (μ=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], σ=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]). Decomposing into R, G, B channels exposes chrominance distribution imbalances.

visual_story.title: 196 Vision Transformer Patches
visual_story.body: ViT-B/16 slices the 224×224 aligned face into 196 non-overlapping 16×16 spatial patches. Multi-head self-attention models cross-patch semantic coherence to identify generative synthesis seams.
visual_story.footnote: 14×14 Patch Matrix • Linear Projection + Positional Embeddings

visual_story.title: Dual-Backbone Inference
visual_story.body: Both backbones evaluate the exact same aligned crop. EfficientNet-B3 analyzes convolutional texture gradients; ViT-B/16 evaluates global spatial patch attention.
visual_story.footnote: Dual Model Ensemble • Calibrated Softmax Probabilities

visual_story.title: 2D FFT Optical Spectrum
visual_story.body: 2D Fast Fourier Transform shifts spatial pixels into optical frequency domain. Generative models (GANs, Diffusion, Latent Upsamplers) leave distinctive periodic lattice artifacts and high-frequency roll-off anomalies.

visual_story.title: Where EfficientNet looked
visual_story.body: Warm pixels illustrate gradient attribution on EfficientNet's final convolutional layer. They expose the exact spatial regions (eyes, mouth contour, skin texture) that triggered the model's prediction.

visual_story.title: Ocular Zoom & Corneal Reflection
visual_story.body: High-resolution ocular crops inspect pupil circularity and specular reflection symmetry between the eyes. Generative models often generate physically inconsistent specular reflection angles.
